svg.title: Copilot Agentic Business Process
svg.desc: A reusable Business Process Core accelerates development of high-value, long-running, human-guided, auditable business processes. The GitHub Copilot harness is the agent runtime inside Microsoft Copilot Studio, not the separate GitHub Copilot service.
